newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in thin after-hours trade on Monday, pressured by the yen's rise against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.6 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.4 yen lower at 142.0 yen. Volume was extremely thin with only 2,986 lots traded.

During the day, private investors retreated to the sidelines amid uncertainty over the currency market and the holiday in Singapore. "The near-term direction hinges on the currency market," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
